status: 500-m stress-test family frozen after positive 2-km subset result and before any 500-m vertical outcome
role: post-freeze exploratory robustness stress test; not independent confirmation, not rescue, and cannot alter v0.3.8

provenance.interpretation_rule: Because this 500-m refinement is opened after the positive 2-km result, treat it as a preflight-supported stress test rather than independent confirmatory evidence.

subset.exclusion_reason: only 1/12 retained at all predeclared fine grids under matched speed2_turn2 preflight

ecological_question: Does the already-observed four-panel within-context vertical identity survive a much stricter 500-m horizontal match while speed×turning state is also standardized?

estimator.vertical_centering: subtract each retained session median from all retained numeric-height events before selecting valid kinematic endpoints
estimator.conditional_profile: P(centered residual height | 500-m cell, speed×turn state)
estimator.common_weighting: equal-session self distribution over jointly supported 500-m cell×state strata, applied identically to self and other profiles
estimator.target_scoring: target kinematic endpoints whose 500-m cell×state stratum is supported by both predictors

calibration.permutation_unit: whole centered session block with fixed x-y-time-derived speed×turn states
calibration.preserve: within-session 500-m-place-state-residual-z observations and exact session-count multiset per label
calibration.panel_stress_pass_rule: exact preflight n; calibrated common 500-m-place-state identity > 0; one-sided p(null>=observed)<=0.05

decision_matrix.3_or_4_pass: Strong 500-m robustness within the four structurally evaluable panels: individuality persists under much finer spatial matching as well as kinematic-state matching.
decision_matrix.1_or_2_pass: Mixed fine-scale robustness: sub-kilometre route allocation may explain substantial residual individuality in some systems.
decision_matrix.0_pass: The positive 2-km result does not survive 500-m matching; fine-scale route allocation becomes a leading explanation within the subset.

synthesis.generalization_limit: No inference to Eidolon. Because this is post-2-km refinement, it is a stress test rather than independent confirmatory evidence.

claim_boundary: 500-m cells remain matching strata, not exact flight paths, feeding trees or resources.
A PASS does not prove intrinsic phenotype; sub-500-m route, microhabitat and environmental exposure can remain.
A FAIL cannot erase the positive 2-km result; it would localize the residual mechanism below 2 km.
This family cannot alter the frozen v0.3.8 submission.
stop_rule: Do not change subset, 500-m grid, speed2_turn2 definition, centering, bins, 50-event support, expected n, permutation B/seeds or pass rule after any 500-m output.
Do not open 1-km as a rescue if 500-m fails; the predeclared 2-km result remains separate.
If any observed n differs from the matched preflight expected n, invalidate rather than retune.
